en.plugins.truthdare.desc: Truth or Dare for friends and couples
en.plugins.truthdare.usage:
*Truth or Dare (AV)*

{0}av - A random truth or dare
{0}av truth - A truth question
{0}av dare - A dare
{0}av mode - Show the current mode
{0}av mode <mild|flirty|romantic|adult> - Change the mode (group admins and owners)
{0}av on|off - Enable or disable it in this chat (group admins and owners)

*Modes:* mild, flirty, romantic, adult
_The questions and dares are written in French._
en.plugins.truthdare.disabled: ❌ Truth or Dare is disabled in this chat. A group admin can enable it with {0}av on.
en.plugins.truthdare.mode_changed: ✅ Truth or Dare mode changed to: {0}
